dossier.scp_unleashed.409.title: Contagious Crystal
dossier.scp_unleashed.409.caption: SCP-409 at intake, its granite case opened under supervision.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-409 is to remain inside its granite case at all times, with the lid lowered. **The case is the containment.** The case is to be stored on a stone floor, well away from livestock and from any area where animals are kept or may stray.
The lid is not to be raised without the written approval of two senior researchers, and then only for as long as strictly necessary. Personnel attending an opening are to %rcome dressed for it%r.
Any person or animal showing crystalline growths is to be isolated at once and observed from a distance until further instruction. Remains are to be swept up with long-handled tools and sealed away.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-409 is a cluster of translucent cyan crystal roughly 9 cm across, resting on a bed of dark cloth inside a case carved from a single block of granite. The crystal gives off a faint, cold light. Its composition matches no known mineral.

Exposure to SCP-409 produces crystalline growths on the body of the subject. The growths are identical in appearance to SCP-409 and first emerge as a few small clusters. Over time they multiply and enlarge, and the subject's movements grow increasingly stiff and laboured.

The process has been observed in humans and in every animal species exposed so far. No conventional treatment has slowed it. In every recorded case it has ended in the death of the subject, whose body breaks apart into shards of crystal that lose their light within minutes.
Subjects in the later stages describe the growths as cold, painless and very heavy.

page.title: Addendum 409-1: Incident Log
text: Incident 409-02: the case was opened for photography in a converted stable. %rThe horses were not moved out first.%r By the end of the month the stable stood empty.
Incident 409-05: a researcher who assisted with the cleanup later reported cold patches spreading across the back of one hand. %rRecord sealed.%r
Incident 409-07: the case was found with its lid raised and no record of who had opened it. A rat recovered from beneath the shelving glittered faintly in the torchlight.

page.title: Addendum 409-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-409 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file inside its granite case, lid down, by the unidentified individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. Asked how the object should be handled, the individual would say only that the case is the containment. See field notes.

block.scp_unleashed.scp409_case.tooltip: A long case of polished granite, far heavier than it looks.
block.scp_unleashed.scp409_case.detail.1: Brass hinges along the back, a single hasp at the front.
block.scp_unleashed.scp409_case.detail.2: A faint cold light leaks out whenever the lid is raised.

message.scp_unleashed.scp409.stage.1: A cold prickle runs under your skin.
message.scp_unleashed.scp409.stage.2: Something hard is pushing up through your skin.
message.scp_unleashed.scp409.stage.3: Your joints grind when you move.
message.scp_unleashed.scp409.stage.5: The crystal has reached your heart.

gamerule.scp409MobSpread.description: When off, SCP-409 no longer passes from one animal or monster to another. People can still catch it and pass it on.

commands.scp_unleashed.scp409.cure.none_: None of the targets carried SCP-409

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp409_case.1: A long case carved from polished granite, holding SCP-409. The case is the containment. Right-click the lid to raise or lower it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp409_case.2: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-409 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress will bring the case to you, closed.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp409.0: The courier brought this one in a granite case.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp409.1: Leave the lid down until you know why.
